messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

trembling,","verse":21},{"chapter":8,"text":"at whose bidding they are changed to wind and fire, whose word is sure, and sayings constant, whose ordinance is strong, and commandment fearful,","verse":22},{"chapter":8,"text":"whose look dries up the depths, and whose indignation makes the mountains to melt away, and whose truth bears witness—","verse":23},{"chapter":8,"text":"hear, O Lord, the prayer of your servant, and give ear to the petition of your handiwork.","verse":24},{"chapter":8,"text":"Attend to my words, for as long as I live, I will speak, and as long as I have understanding, I will answer.","verse":25},{"chapter":8,"text":"Don’t look at the sins of your people, but on those who have served you in truth.","verse":26},{"chapter":8,"text":"Don’t regard the doings of those who act wickedly, but of those who have kept your covenants in affliction.","verse":27},{"chapter":8,"text":"Don’t think about those who have lived wickedly before you, but remember those who have willingly known your fear.","verse":28},{"chapter":8,"text":"Let it not be your will to destroy those who have lived like cattle, but look at those who have clearly taught your law.","verse":29},{"chapter":8,"text":"Don’t be indignant at those who are deemed worse than animals, but love those who have always put their trust in your glory.","verse":30},{"chapter":8,"text":"For we and our fathers have passed our lives in ways that bring death, but you are called merciful because of us sinners.","verse":31},{"chapter":8,"text":"For if you have a desire to have mercy upon us who have no works of righteousness, then you will be called merciful.","verse":32},{"chapter":8,"text":"For the just, which have many good works laid up with you, will be rewarded for their own deeds.","verse":33},{"chapter":8,"text":"For what is man, that you should take displeasure at him? Or what is a corruptible race, that you should be so bitter toward it?","verse":34},{"chapter":8,"text":"For in truth, there is no man among those who are born who has not done wickedly, and among those who have lived, there is none which have not done wrong.","verse":35},{"chapter":8,"text":"For in this, O Lord, your righteousness and your goodness will be declared, if you are merciful to those who have no store of good works.”","verse":36},{"chapter":8,"text":"Then he answered me, “Some things you have spoken rightly, and it will happen according to your words.","verse":37},{"chapter":8,"text":"For indeed I will not think about the fashioning of those who have sinned, or about their death, their judgment, or their destruction;","verse":38},{"chapter":8,"text":"but I will rejoice over the creation of the righteous and their pilgrimage, their salvation, and the reward that they will have.","verse":39},{"chapter":8,"text":"Therefore as I have spoken, so it will be.","verse":40}]}
